topic: Demography data availability and recalibration scripts
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered the status of device demography data across various countries. It was noted that only Brazilian demography remained active on the production UI, and other country sources were empty in the database.

Regarding data gaps, one participant mentioned adding African (AFA) data and removing Finnish data for testing purposes. A follow-up discussion confirmed that all data is available up to October 24th, but some client demography was deactivated after initial implementation.

A separate technical topic involved the recalibration of calibration levels, specifically mentioning India. It was discussed how a participant trained another team member on updating these levels using specific SQL scripts and documentation links (e.g., `session_recalibration_facility.sql`). The need for proper testing selects was also addressed.
decisions: The status of other country demography data sources needs further investigation.
AFA data will be added, and Finnish data will be removed/updated.
action_items: One participant will follow up on the availability of demography data for remaining countries.
The team member who was trained on recalibration levels should use documentation links to perform updates independently after release.
